name: Maid to be Yours
source:
As you slowly chip away at your college assignments, you find yourself neglecting everything else about your life. You don't really have the energy to cook or clean anymore by this point. But after a well timed dream about a cute maid and certain circumstances occur, your friend ends up living with you for the month! Could this be the change you need in your life?  

[From [url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/maid-to-be-yours]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你慢慢地完成大学作业时，你会发现自己忽视了生活中的其他一切。此时你已经没有精力再做饭或打扫卫生了。但是，在一次关于可爱女仆的适时梦想以及某些情况发生之后，你的朋友最终会和你住在一起一个月！这可能是你生活中需要的改变吗？

[来自[url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/maid-to-be-yours]itch.io[/url]]
